name: Martian Moons eXploration (MMX)
location_str: Yoshinobu LC-LP-2 @ Tanegashima Space Center, JPN
slot_a_text: MMX is a Japanese scientific mission to land on Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars, to collect samples before bringing them back to Earth. The mission includes a small French/German rover to explore the surface of Phobos.
slot_b_text: First scheduled in 2023, it has moved three times since. The current time was set 2 months ago and has held since. The window is instantaneous, so it goes on time or not at all.
description: MMX is a Japanese scientific mission to land on Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars, to collect samples before bringing them back to Earth. The mission includes a small French/German rover to explore the surface of Phobos.
rocket_fact: H3 insulation is sprayed-on silicone instead of hand-glued cork.
